title: `assert.deepEqual` loops forever with circular refs

labels.name: assert
labels.description: Issues and PRs related to the assert subsystem.

body:
<!--
Thanks for wanting to report an issue you've found in Node.js. Please fill in
the template below by replacing the html comments with an appropriate answer.
If unsure about something, just do as best as you're able.

version: usually output of `node -v`
platform:  either `uname -a` output, or if Windows, version and 32 or 64-bit.
subsystem:  optional -- if known please specify affected core module name.

It will be much easier for us to fix the issue if a test case that reproduces
the problem is provided. Ideally this test case should not have any external
dependencies. We understand that it is not always possible to reduce your code

Thank you!
-->

**Version**: `v4.4.3`

**Platform**: `Linux 3.13.0-24-generic #47-Ubuntu SMP Fri May 2 23:30:00 UTC 2014 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`

<!-- Enter your issue details below this comment. -->

**Code**:

``` js
var assert = require('assert');

var b = {};
b.b = b;

var c = {};
c.b = c;

assert.deepEqual(b, c);
```

**Expected**: no exceptions.

**Actual**: `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`

**See also**:
- https://github.com/nodejs/node-v0.x-archive/issues/207
- https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v4.4.3/test/parallel/test-assert.js#L369-L381
- https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v4.4.3/test/parallel/test-assert.js#L387
